title: Arrest model: run measured acceleration pulses
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The model uses idealised half-sine pulses. Measured traces from data/accel/ would test whether real pulse shapes change peak loads. Depends on: ridebelt-accel-002 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Add an input path for measured CSV traces (data/accel schema), run every available dataset, and compare peaks with the half-sine design cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads the data/accel schema without manual edits
Comparison table added to load-analysis.md as DRAFT
Flags any trace exceeding the 6 kN design load
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
